integrity: Finite integer calculations are generated from the graph definition by the included standalone checker; another exhaustive enumeration and original simplicial binary ranks corroborate the result. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The integral homology and first nontrivial homotopy group are proved for the specific bidirected octahedral graph K_{2,2,2}; no claim is made about higher attaching maps, general multipartite graphs, or an integral symmetry representation.
title: Three integral homology degrees in the bidirected octahedral multipath complex
